i-Shepherd Course Terms & Policy Agreement

Official Policy Document / 官方课程须知与重要提醒

Status: Active & Binding Official Policy Reference
1

Non-Refundable / 不可退款规定

English: Once payment is processed, the package is strictly non-refundable.

中文: 费用一旦支付成功,课时包将严格执行不可退款规定。

2

Transferable / 课时转让性

English: You may transfer the remaining sessions to another student if needed.

中文: 如果需要,您可以将剩余课时转让给其他学生。

3

One Student Per Package / 限单人专享使用

English: Each package is strictly dedicated to one student at a time and cannot be shared simultaneously.

中文: 本课时包严格仅限一名学生使用,不可多人同时共用。

4

Leave of Absence / 请假制度

English: You may request a leave of absence anytime before the scheduled class. Failure to notify us beforehand will result in the session being marked as an unexcused absence.

中文: 您可以在常规课程开始前的任何时间申请请假。若未提前通知且缺席,该堂课将计为旷课(扣除课时)。

5

Emergencies & Illness / 突发情况与生病处理

English: In case of sudden illness or emergencies, please inform us as soon as possible so we can waive the absence and credit the session back to you.

中文: 遇到紧急突发情况或生病时,请及时通知我们,我们将免除旷课标记并保留该课时。

6

Class Reminders & No-Show Policy / 上课提醒与缺席规则

English: The teacher will send two chat notifications before class: first, a warm greeting reminder, and second, an alert stating the teacher has entered the classroom. If no leave request is received from the parent or student after both reminders, the session will be marked as absent, and the teacher may leave the classroom after waiting for 15 minutes.

中文: 老师在上课前会发送两次通知:第一次是上课问候提醒,第二次是告知老师已经进入课堂。在这两次提醒后,如果家长或学生仍未向我们申请请假,老师将判定学生缺席,并可在等待15分钟后退出课堂。

7

Late Class Attendance / 迟到入课说明

English: If you notify us in advance that the student will be late, we can absolutely accommodate the delay, provided the student logs in. However, if the student fails to show up at all, the session will be marked as absent.

中文: 如果学生无法准时上课并提前通知我们,只要学生最终进入课堂,这种延迟安排是允许的。但如果学生最终未露面,该节课将照常计为缺席。

8

Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) / 保密协议

English: Please note that our conversation, the offered packages, and the pricing are strictly confidential. Sharing this information with anyone else may result in the forfeiture of the remaining package sessions.

中文: 请务必注意,我们的此次私信沟通、推荐的课程套餐及价格均属于严格保密信息。切勿向任何人透露或提及,否则未消耗的课时可能会被作废。

9

Referral Reward / 推荐老带新奖励

English: Refer i-Shepherd to a friend! Receive 2 free sessions credited to your package once they enroll.

中文: 推荐 i-Shepherd 在线辅导服务给好友,在其成功报名后,您的现有套餐将获得额外赠送的2节免费课。

10

Testimonial Bonus / 好评反馈奖励

English: Send us a short video testimonial sharing your child's learning experience, and get 2 free bonus sessions!

中文: 向我们发送一段优质的视频好评(分享孩子的学习心得),即可再次获得2节免费赠课。

Thank you so much for your continued trust and support!

非常感谢您一直以来的信任与支持！ / i-Shepherd Online Tutorial Services
